rules.sentence: Thrombocytopenia-related bleeding typically presents as petechiae, non-palpable purpura, and ecchymosis.
A repeat CBC helps confirm thrombocytopenia and rule out laboratory error.
Hepatomegaly and splenomegaly suggest conditions such as lymphoma, chronic liver disease, or other hematologic disorders.
Lymphadenopathy may indicate infection, autoimmune disease, lymphoma, or malignancy.
